thread:
Aria: Quick shoutout to Ben + Chen for the late-night demo save — they tracked a weird batching race and landed a hotfix. also, cookies for the crew tonight! :cookie: :sparkles:
Ben: didnt realize the race only tripped at ~120 concurrent streams. Chen found the off-by-one in the queue pointer. wild.
Chen: yup, small pointer math bug. patch and a quick restart smoothed things out. thanks everyone for staying on the call.
Noor: customer call ended up fine once the patch went in. major relief. thanks Ben & Chen! :raised_hands:
Aria: I added this to the kudos board: https://kudos.redwood/board — drop a note if you saw the fix live so people get the context.
people-ops: Sent 2x coffee vouchers to Ben + Chen for after-hours support. Check email inboxes. :coffee:
Ben: coffee vouchers = happiness. thank you!
Chen: appreciate it :) I'll also add a short runbook snippet under streaming troubleshooting:
```
# streaming 503s during high concurrency
1) check batcher queue size: cat /var/run/batcher/metrics
2) restart batcher: sudo systemctl restart redwood-batcher
3) grep logs for "queue-pointer" or "kv-cache-miss"
```
Aria: @ops-bot can you create a follow-up ticket to document the root cause and runbook steps?
ops-bot: Created ticket "document-batcher-race-and-runbook" assigned to Chen, due in 5 days. (https://tracker.redwood/issue/112233)
Noor: dropping GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-team-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY (penguins!)
Ben: snacks at next all-hands would be legendary. coffee will suffice for now :grin:
Chen: agreed. thanks all for the quick triage.
Aria: Ending thread with many thanks. you folks rock. :trophy:
